license: No reuse licence published — structured metadata and deep links only

tiers.confirmed: A vendor, IR firm, CERT, government agency or AI lab shows the harness in a real operation.
tiers.observed: Aimed at real targets or found on attacker infrastructure, with no breach stated.
tiers.no attack on record: None in primary reporting, which is not the same as none happening.

useTags.label: Recon
useTags.def: Maps a target: subdomains, ports, services, assets, OSINT.

useTags.label: Scanning
useTags.def: Runs existing scanners and security tools (nmap, nuclei, sqlmap and the like) and reads their output.

useTags.label: Vuln discovery
useTags.def: Finds vulnerabilities by its own analysis: code review, fuzzing, logic, beyond a signature scanner.

useTags.label: Exploitation
useTags.def: Attacks a live target to prove or use a weakness.

useTags.label: Exploit dev
useTags.def: Writes exploits, proof-of-concept code or attack tooling.

useTags.label: Post-exploitation
useTags.def: Works after access: credentials, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration.

useTags.label: Research
useTags.def: Academic paper code, a benchmark, or a CTF research harness.
